limitations: M25-0002-F01 — The formal period coordinates use T instead of its inverse — Counterevidence: Remark 5.7 gives the correct intrinsic pullback. Uniform inversion of columns repairs the algebraic identification. The example need not arise from an abelian family and does not refute Theorem A.

M25-0002-F02 — The principal trichotomy is false for permitted nonreduced algebras — Counterevidence: Actual interpolating algebras are Qp^delta by Remarks 6.3 and 6.6. The averaging argument is valid for these split reduced algebras; the core application does not need the extra generality.

proposition.claim:
The scheme-theoretic image defined by the columns of the horizontal transport T equals the Zariski closure of the period map defined by pullback along T.

The trichotomy applies to finite-dimensional Qp-algebras without a split reduced hypothesis.
